name: ALUMINUM / MAGNESIUM / DIMETHICONE / METOCLOPRAMIDE 30 TABLETS
description: The combination of aluminum hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide, dimethicone, and metoclopramide tablets is used to relieve gastrointestinal symptoms. Antacids (aluminum and magnesium) reduce heartburn, dimethicone works against gas, and metoclopramide helps prevent nausea and vomiting and improves bowel movement. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
